DEFINITION
TERMINAL DECIMALS - A terminal decimal is a number that has an end. A terminal decimal results when the division used to convert a fraction reaches a remainder of zero.
DEFINITION
REPEATING DECIMALS - A repeating decimal results when the division used to convert a fraction reaches a point where a digit or sequence of digits continues to repeat.
The rational number 7/22 produces a repeating decimal number. Notice it repeats a particular sequence after the first number (3).
